data.title: Buying Bitcoin Now Is Like Buying Amazon – You Just Don’t Know Which Part Of The Ride, Says Wall Street Veteran Dave Weisberger
data.description: Buying Bitcoin (BTC) today is less about whether the asset succeeds and more about when investors enter the cycle, according to veteran trader Dave Weisberger.Speaking on The Wolf Of All Streets podcast, Weisberger drew a parallel between buying Bitcoin and buying Amazon (AMZN) before its historic…
